faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Asansol Durgapur Police Commissionerate in West Bengal for filling contractual driver positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 15 vacancies have been announced for the Driver (Contractual Basis) post under advertisement number 2242-E.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Driver post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class VIII from a recognized school and possess a valid Four-Wheeler Driving License (LMV / HMV) along with relevant driving experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 21 and 40 years of age as on the date of advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What salary will be provided to selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 16,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 31 October 2026, which is approximately 14 days from the notification date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in offline mode by hand in the drop box at the Office of the Commissioner of Police, Asansol-Durgapur Police Commissionerate.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Driving Test & Interview carrying 40 marks in total, followed by a Medical Examination and Verification of Character and Antecedents.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely temporary and contractual in nature for a period of 1 year, with potential renewal based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official application form?
faq.answer: You can download the prescribed application format and official notification from the official West Bengal Police website at https://wbpolice.gov.in/.
